The '''Derrbi Wastelands''' or '''Derrbi Wastes''' was a rocky area of canyons on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romar]]. When [[Jai Raventhorn]] was on the planet to kill the man responsible for her lover's [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Antoll Jellrek]], she hid her [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Doomsayer]]'', in one of the Derrbi canyons.
